notes.title: Lover Interface launches on 2025/10/03! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]The BL visual novel [i]Lover Interface[/i] will be officially released on [b]October 3rd, 2025[/b] on Steam.[/h2][p][/p][h3]The full version includes:
✨ Complete romance routes with multiple endings
✨ New CGs and story events
✨ The long-awaited reveal of the “special slot” from the demo[/h3][p][/p][p]📅 Release Date: October 3rd, 2025
💻 Platform: Steam (Windows)
💬 Languages: Traditional Chinese, English[/p][p][/p][h3]Add the game to your wishlist now to be notified at launch!
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3366940" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff809f"]👉 Lover Interface[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Lover Interface Demo 1.0.4 Update Notice

notes.title: Lover Interface Demo Coming on May 15, 2025!
notes.content:
Hello, this is MuYou.
[h1]The free demo of BL visual novel Lover Interface will be released on May 15, 2025 (CST) on Steam![/h1]
[h2]In the demo, you’ll experience the beginning of the story, where the protagonist Ethan Syu unexpectedly gains access to an affection interface and has his first interactions with several key characters.[/h2]
[h3]Welcome to try the demo, share your thoughts, and stream your gameplay! Your feedback will help shape the continued development of the game.[/h3]
Thank you again for your support, and don’t forget to add Lover Interface to your wishlist!
